query: Start the news item for CCAL-512 — it's a Cluster: How to Prepare a Preventive Maintenance Plan blog post with a Confluence draft linked in the ticket, and I dropped featuredimg.png in the repo root.
expected_behavior: Runs the marketing-pages preflight guard (content.sh check-repo) and refuses to write content if the checkout is not marketing-pages

Reads the Jira ticket via acli, extracts the Confluence inline-card link and target SEO keywords, and derives + confirms the slug (e.g. how-to-prepare-a-preventive-maintenance-plan) before uploading anything

Resolves the destination, front-matter schema, permitted components, and CDN folders from the repo's content profile (content.sh pipeline/collection/image) instead of hardcoded paths, and stops with a message naming what it needed if the repo declares none
Fetches the Confluence draft and its referenced images, converts images to webp, and uploads the featured and inline images to the folders the profile declares for each role

Writes the article at the resolved destination with the declared front matter, using each image role's `reference` value verbatim rather than assembling a CDN path by hand, and assembles the body from the permitted component palette rather than authoring its own hero/CTA/SEO

Converts facilitron.com URLs to relative internal paths and verifies each resolves via check-link, consulting the profile's declared link exceptions, and writes a real alt-text description on every image
Produces copy with no em dashes (Facilitron voice), runs the served-HTML verification on this worktree, and cleans up the dropped-in featured image and /tmp working directory
